import com.webcommander.client.ApiResponse;
import java.util.Map;

ApiResponse response = client.customerGroups().createCustomerGroup(Map.of("customer_group", Map.of(
        "name", "Wholesale Partners", "description", "Trade accounts", "status", "active",
        "purchase_preference", Map.of(
                "minimum_purchase", Map.of("enabled", true, "amount", 50),
                "on_account_purchase", Map.of(
                        "enabled", true, "max_purchase", Map.of("enabled", true, "amount", 500),
                        "credit_limit", Map.of("enabled", true, "amount", 1000),
                        "payment_terms", Map.of("enabled", true, "terms", "NET_30"))),
        "tax_configuration", Map.of(
                "override_store_tax", true, "tax_exempt", false, "tax_message", "Prices exclude GST",
                "show_prices_with_tax_included", true, "prices_entered_with_tax_included", false,
                "base_price_rounding", "up"),
        "product_display", Map.of(
                "overwrite_default", true, "variation_display_type", "enable_matrix_view",
                "display_parent_image", true, "activate_colour_variation_image", false,
                "show_selected_variation_value", true, "strike_through_out_of_stock", false,
                "single_click_variation_loading", true, "price_display_method", "highest"))));
Map<?, ?> group = (Map<?, ?>) ((Map<?, ?>) response.getMap()).get("customer_group");
Map<?, ?> onAccount = (Map<?, ?>) ((Map<?, ?>) group.get("purchase_preference")).get("on_account_purchase");
System.out.println(group.get("id") + " " + group.get("status") + " " + ((Map<?, ?>) onAccount.get("payment_terms")).get("terms"));
